{{Top|leg}}
The '''Rites of Conch-tar''' was a ceremony that was considered sacred by the [[Anguilla]], an aquatic [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alluuvia]]. The ceremony was performed by individuals who were seeking to prove their worth, and it involved entering a submerged cave and there, consuming a piece of of phosphorescent seaweed, which via a creature known as a [[piscator]] caused those who ate the seaweed to be overcame by a sense of fear. To complete the rites, an individual had to remain inside the cave and confront their fears. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents traveled to Alluuvia and to prove that their intentions towards the Anguilla were honorable, the agents engaged in the Rites of Conch-tar.
